create_base_dataset: create a BaseDataset instance for VGGT training with common configuration settings
build_target_shape: build a target image shape array based on a given aspect ratio and patch size alignment
process_one_image: process a single image with depth map, camera matrices, and return world and camera coordinate points
sample_nearby_ids: sample nearby frame IDs from a sequence around a start index with configurable expand range
test_get_data: test the abstract get_data method that must be implemented by each concrete dataset subclass
